# pub.dev

> Pub.dev is the official Dart and Flutter package repository, hosting thousands of open-source libraries for building cross-platform applications.

Pub.dev serves as the central package manager for the Dart ecosystem, enabling developers to discover, evaluate, and integrate packages for Flutter mobile development, server-side Dart, and web applications. The platform provides quality scoring, publisher verification, and comprehensive documentation for each package.

## Key Topics

- Flutter
- Dart
- State Management
- Firebase
- Camera Plugin
- Image Processing
- Cross-Platform Development
- Flutter Packages
- BLoC Pattern
- Google Fonts
- Publisher Directory
- Package Scoring
- Native Integration
- Mobile Development
- Plugin Architecture

## Core Package Directory

- [Top packages](https://pub.dev/packages): Main package directory and search interface for the Dart ecosystem
- [Package scores & pub points](https://pub.dev/help/scoring): Explains Pub package scoring system and quality metrics evaluation

## Official Publishers

- [Flutter.dev packages](https://pub.dev/publishers/flutter.dev): Official Flutter SDK packages and plugins directory
- [Google.dev packages](https://pub.dev/publishers/google.dev): Google open-source Dart and Flutter packages directory
- [Firebase.google.com packages](https://pub.dev/publishers/firebase.google.com): Firebase plugins for Flutter and Dart packages directory

## State Management Packages

- [flutter_bloc](https://pub.dev/packages/flutter_bloc): Flutter BLoC pattern state management package documentation
- [flutter_mobx](https://pub.dev/packages/flutter_mobx): MobX state management integration for Flutter applications
- [BLoC library publisher](https://pub.dev/publishers/bloclibrary.dev): BLoC library publisher packages directory and overview
- [Vyuh.tech publisher](https://pub.dev/publishers/vyuh.tech): Vyuh framework and reactive programming packages directory

## Backend & Core Libraries

- [firebase_core](https://pub.dev/packages/firebase_core): Firebase Core plugin enabling multi-app Firebase connections
- [built_collection](https://pub.dev/packages/built_collection): Immutable collections package with builder pattern support

## Camera & Image Processing

- [camera_extended](https://pub.dev/packages/camera_extended): Extended Flutter camera plugin with sensor-level aspect ratio
- [camera_extended_android](https://pub.dev/packages/camera_extended_android): Android camera plugin with native aspect ratio support
- [camera_extended_ios](https://pub.dev/packages/camera_extended_ios): iOS camera plugin implementation with aspect ratio control
- [camera_extended_platform_interface](https://pub.dev/packages/camera_extended_platform_interface): Platform interface for camera_extended plugin
- [flutter_bicubic_resize](https://pub.dev/packages/flutter_bicubic_resize): High-performance image resizing and compression for Flutter
- [Codigee publisher](https://pub.dev/publishers/codigee.com): Codigee publisher packages for image and camera processing

## UI & Integration Libraries

- [google_fonts](https://pub.dev/packages/google_fonts): Flutter package for Google Fonts integration with caching
- [unity_kit](https://pub.dev/packages/unity_kit): Flutter plugin for Unity 3D integration and communication
- [Ravenlab publisher](https://pub.dev/publishers/ravenlab.tech): Ravenlab publisher packages for native and image processing
